The badge is driven by broadcast info alone: [useVoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts](/app/src/voice-broadcast/hooks/useVoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts:60) returns a boolean, and [VoiceBroadcastHeader.tsx](/app/src/voice-broadcast/components/atoms/VoiceBroadcastHeader.tsx:57) renders the same badge for every true value. [LiveBadge.tsx](/app/src/voice-broadcast/components/atoms/LiveBadge.tsx:22) has no grey style.

The likely fix spans those files and [VoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts](/app/src/voice-broadcast/models/VoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts:390): derive liveness from playback and info state, expose `getLiveness()`, and emit a change only when that value changes. The hook should subscribe to that event. [VoiceBroadcastChunkEvents.ts](/app/src/voice-broadcast/utils/VoiceBroadcastChunkEvents.ts:28) needs tail detection using its sorted event sequence. Header callers and the existing boolean based tests will need the union type.

The expected transitions to cover are buffering before a chunk and after the current last chunk (`grey`), chunk playback (`live`), and stopped playback or stopped broadcast (`not-live`). The issue leaves precedence between paused playback and paused broadcast info somewhat ambiguous; its description suggests grey for either pause. I recorded the findings in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). This specialist pass made no project source or test edits.

Implemented three-state voice broadcast liveness. Playback now reports and emits `live`, `grey`, or `not-live` as playback and broadcast info change; the hook and header use that value, and the badge has a grey style. I also added last-chunk detection and updated the relevant tests and snapshots.

All 24 voice broadcast test suites pass (218 tests). ESLint, stylelint, and `git diff --check` pass. The repository type check still reports an unrelated existing error at [notifications.ts](/app/src/utils/notifications.ts:79).

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** [VoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts](/app/src/voice-broadcast/models/VoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts:299) can play a chunk through `skipTo()` while its state remains `Paused` or `Buffering`. `getLiveness()` then stays `"grey"` and emits no `LivenessChanged` event during playback. Set the state to `Playing` when seeking starts a chunk, and cover that transition in the existing playback tests.

**Tests:** `./node_modules/.bin/jest --runInBand --watch=false test/voice-broadcast/components/atoms/LiveBadge-test.tsx test/voice-broadcast/components/atoms/VoiceBroadcastHeader-test.tsx test/voice-broadcast/components/molecules/VoiceBroadcastPlaybackBody-test.tsx test/voice-broadcast/models/VoiceBroadcastPlayback-test.ts test/voice-broadcast/utils/VoiceBroadcastChunkEvents-test.ts` — passed: 5 suites, 65 tests, 7 snapshots.

**TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM:** `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --jsx react` failed at the unchanged [notifications.ts](/app/src/utils/notifications.ts:79): `sendReadReceipt` receives three arguments, but the installed type definition accepts at most two. Resolve that API/type mismatch and rerun the check.
